description: MED model with GOR vs TBT and N_effects, scaling limits, BPE correction

unit.name: Low-temperature MED plant (LT-MED, 12-effect)
unit.source: El-Dessouky et al. (2000) Chem. Eng. J. 79 165-183; Ettouney (2006) Desalination

T_scale_limit.note: CaCO3 scale onset for MED (lower than MSF; El-Dessouky 2000)

k_scale.note: SEC penalty per degC above scale limit (2% per degC)

eta_eff.note: Per-effect efficiency (accounts for BPE, NEA, heat losses)

BPE_per_effect.note: Boiling point elevation per effect (NaCl solution, ~35 g/L)

pump_SEC_ref.note: Reference pumping SEC (MED lower than MSF; El-Dessouky: 1-2 kWh/m3)
